description: Search LinkNHV (New Haven, CT), also called Link New Haven, the human-curated directory of websites for New Haven, Connecticut. Give keywords (e.g. "thai food", "food pantry", "pothole"), a tag, a collection, or a mix. Returns up to 10 listings a page (name, description, website, LinkNHV collection pages, last checked date); page through at most 5 pages. Typos are corrected and questions are matched to tags, as on linknhv.com.

collection.description: An exact collection or grouping name from list_collections.

tag.description: An exact LinkNHV tag name (e.g. "pizza", "downtown"); several comma-separated tags must all match.

name: search_listings
